articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview


This release introduces several important improvements focused on real-world Wi-Fi reliability, seamless mobility, and smarter network management. It brings meaningful refinements that enhance roaming consistency, reduce network congestion, and streamline configuration workflows for UniFi deployments.


Improved Client Roaming Experience
Optimizes client handoff behavior on non-MLO (single-link) Wi-Fi networks to provide smoother transitions between access points. These improvements reduce latency and interruptions during roaming, especially for mobile, VoIP, and streaming devices that move frequently across coverage zones.
This enhancement ensures more stable connections and minimizes the temporary stalls or re-authentications that could previously occur during AP transitions.

articles.title: UniFi Access Point (U7 and E7 models) 8.2.14

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is only for these models:

U6-LR/U6-Lite/U6+
UAP-nanoHD/FlexHD/BeaconHD/IW-HD

Improvements

Added Channel AI support.
Added Roaming Assistant support.
Added Quick Airtime Scan support. No client disconnects during scan.
Improved overall AP stability.
Improved client connectivity performance.
Updated regulatory compliance for Brazil.

Bugfixes

Fixed NanoHD incorrectly selecting channel bandwidth after a DFS event.
Fixed U6+ reporting disconnect/reconnect events when clients roam between bands.
Fixed upgrade issue on U6+.
Fixed Proxy ARP issue when a station has multiple IP addresses.
Fixed RADIUS timeout issue when multiple servers are used.
Fixed RADIUS accounting issue with incorrect values.
Fixed RADIUS accounting issue where values were missing from STOP messages.


Additional information
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
